counterexamples_and_failures: Continuous impedance rescaling at fixed charge and native dynamics defeats charge-only scale selection.
Same transferred charge can have zero final mean oscillator energy after a full-period constant current drive.
Fixed means with squeezed covariance yield distinct total energies.
Sharp noncompact oscillator charge is not a normalizable finite-energy state.
Target-selected Z or assumed chi=hbar does not independently recover hbar.
limitations: No actual source, device, calibration dataset, quantum channel or uncertainty budget supplied.
One-mode covariance formula is not full coupled-system total energy.
Finite fixtures are not proofs over all Hilbert domains; general conditional arguments are documented.
No claim that the native ledger supplies an impedance selection law; that search is the next task.
